description.value:
Requirements You're holding a grenade requiring a Reflex save.

If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with a burst area that requires a basic Reflex save, the spell doesn't take effect and is instead installed into the required grenade. Until the end of your next turn, any creature caught in the area of that grenade is also affected by the installed spell; creatures don't attempt a separate Reflex save against the spell and instead use the same result they rolled against the grenade. Resolve the grenade's effects first, then the spell's effects.
